newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait aviation workers halt flight delay strike.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait aviation workers halt flight delay strike.

text.p: Kuwait's aviation workers' union said on Wednesday it had decided to postpone a strike after talks with the country's crown prince.

"The strike has been postponed...We have decided to accept an offer by His Highness (Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah) to try and end the (pay) dispute in two weeks," a senior union source told Reuters.
The society of Kuwaiti pilots and flight engineers had decided on Friday to delay flights from Kuwait airport for an hour starting Wednesday to press state-owned Kuwait Airways Corp to improve wages.
Sheikh Saad, who is also prime minister, held talks with society members on Monday and offered to form a committee to review their demands over the next two weeks.
The society later held an internal vote and the majority opted to accept the offer, union sources said.
